Without this changeset a kept queue's label has no row for ever, so the completion check shows it incomplete and gate 1 can never hold. When to_regclass('nexus.aspect_extraction_queue') is NULL (a fresh install, and almost every other) the changeset registers nothing and is recorded as run; the completion check then counts the label as not applicable (StampLabels.NOT_APPLICABLE_WHEN_ABSENT). A precondition with onFail="CONTINUE" onError="CONTINUE", as vectors-068-18's, skips the changeset, unrecorded, while the table exists without the column (vectors-068-18 was skipped because another role owns the table): the next boot retries it, so it registers once vectors-068-18 has run. preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles r WHERE (r.rolname = 'nexus_svc' AND (r.rolname = current_user OR pg_catalog.pg_has_role(r.oid, current_user, 'USAGE'))) OR (r.rolname <> current_user AND pg_catalog.pg_has_role(r.oid, current_user, 'USAGE') AND NOT r.rolsuper AND NOT r.rolbypassrls AND r.rolcanlogin)) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c WHERE c.oid = to_regclass('nexus.aspect_extraction_queue') AND (NOT pg_catalog.pg_has_role(current_user, c.relowner, 'USAGE') OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute a WHERE a.attrelid = c.oid AND a.attname = 'collection_id' AND NOT a.attisdropped)))

changeSet.comment: Owner-read SELECT policy aspect_extraction_queue_owner_read on nexus.aspect_extraction_queue for the migrating role (RDR-246), so the move rdr229-stamp-aspect_extraction_queue (vectors-070-30) can list the tenants that hold rows and verify them. No other changeset creates an owner-read policy on this table (its tenant_isolation policy is aspects-001's), so this one owns it. The table is absent on most installs: the DO guard does nothing when to_regclass('nexus.aspect_extraction_queue') is NULL, and the rollback is guarded the same way. A precondition with onFail="CONTINUE" onError="CONTINUE" (not MARK_RAN, so that one condition covers both): it skips the changeset, unrecorded, when nexus_svc, or any other login role subject to row-level security, is or inherits the migrating role (vectors-029's guard, word for word), and while the kept table exists but the migrating role does not own it or vectors-068-18 has not given it its collection_id column (the move is not registered then either); the next boot retries. Ends with a post-condition that RAISEs unless the policy names exactly the migrating role. DDL only, no DATA EFFECT.
